senses.gloss: f. (preced.) pack-saddle or cushion, consisting of patches.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:2">Sabb. V, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 52b:19">52ᵇ</cite>) <he>חמור יוצא במ׳ וכ׳</he> an ass may be driven out (on the Sabbath) with the cushion tied on his back (as a protection from cold); ib. 53ᵃ.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:18">Tosef. Kil. V, 18</cite> <he>לא יתן את המ׳ וכ׳</he> one must not put a cushion of patches on his shoulder (on account of the mixture of stuffs, <cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:17">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᵈ</cite> top <he>הטלית שעליו כמ׳ וכ׳</he> his official cloak is as befitting to him as an ass’ pack-saddle; Midr. Sam. ch. VII; a. e.
